question: How can you insert a new row or column MS Excel?

options.text: Use the ‘Copy’ and ‘Paste’ options to insert data.
Apply a new cell style to the entire row or column.
Right-click the row or column and choose ‘Insert’.
Select a row or column and press the ‘Enter’ key.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Right-click the row or column and choose 'Insert'**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Home tab in** MS Excel** is used for **inserting rows and columns**.
 
• The Home tab is one of the main tabs in the Excel ribbon and contains commonly used commands for formatting, editing, and manipulating data in a worksheet.
 
• **To insert rows using the Home tab, follow these steps:**
 
 
• **​**Select the row below which you want to insert a new row. Alternatively, you can select a cell within the row where you want to insert.
 
• On the Home tab, locate the "Cells" group. It is typically located towards the left side of the ribbon.
 
• In the Cells group, you will find the "Insert" button, which looks like a sheet with a plus sign. Click on this button.
 
• Excel will insert a new row above the selected row or cell.
 
 
 
• **To insert columns using the Home tab, follow these steps:**
 
 
• **​**Select the column to the right of which you want to insert a new column. Alternatively, you can select a cell within the column where you want to insert.
 
• On the Home tab, find the "Cells" group.
 
• Within the Cells group, click on the "Insert" button.
 
• Excel will insert a new column to the left of the selected column or cell.
